correctness.rationale: For integer \(n\ge3\), tilted Laplacian winding determinant removes every k-dependent term except full cycle winds; matrix-forest coefficients are n C R and C B, giving the exact fourth derivative. Cyclic discrete second-difference identity yields B_uniform-B=n sum(S_j-mean S)^2. Positivity proves universal bounds and equality, a single large resistance achieves the supremum as a limit, and direct substitution gives two-defect ordering. Full-generator independent exact-rational perturbation comparison succeeded in 42 heterogeneous cases, 90 independent energy identities and 240 two-defect cases; all-size proof does not rely on enumeration.

value.rationale: A sharp n-dependent, all-positive-profile fourth-to-second cumulant envelope with exact lower rigidity and unattained upper supremum provides natural transport-structure comparisons at fixed diffusivity. The analytic Green-energy representation and exact all-separation two-bottleneck extremizers reveal the role of geometry beyond the known two-site modular-chain observation. Claims do not assert uniqueness among all bond-inventory profiles or full transport universality.
